workbookName: Episode Dialog Copy — Craft Wave 2 (35 series)

rows.story_lead: Uncle Matt discovers the opening to Outer Space and sets off to explore it, leaving Gobo behind to pick up the postcards that will follow. A beloved grown-up leaves to chase his own adventure, and Gobo has to find his own way at home while the postcards trickle in.
rows.resolution: Missing Uncle Matt is part of loving him, and the postcards keep the adventure close while Gobo grows into his own exploring.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only: emotion is a synopsis read per the dev set note; no controlled topic fits (Outer Space is the series framing device, not this story's subject); coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low; resolution stays within the series premise and does not invent an episode outcome.

rows.story_lead: Wembley agrees with everyone, and agreeing with the Gorgs lands him in a cage as their loyal subject. Some things that feel like freedom are not freedom at all. Figuring out who his real friends are becomes the job.
rows.resolution: The confusion of pleasing everybody names itself in the end, and Wembley works out who his real friends are by refusing to agree with the Gorgs.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: Wembley is captured and the Gorgs speak of keeping Fraggles as slaves; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Red's Swimming Extravaganza has been building for ages, and the Pool goes dry with no water to fill it. The show is canceled.
rows.resolution: Red's disappointment gets no landing on the page; the synopsis stops before she finds what comes next.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low; resolution states only what the synopsis shows.

rows.segment_title: You Can't Do That Without a Hat
rows.story_lead: Boober is really brave, right up until he loses his lucky hat. He believes the hat is what keeps him brave, and losing it turns his courage upside down.
rows.resolution: Facing the day without the lucky hat is Boober's fear; the thin synopsis does not show how his courage comes back.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only: very thin synopsis (52 chars) per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low; resolution stays within synopsis evidence.

rows.story_lead: Wembley has to decide what job he wants to do, and every option sounds like somebody else's answer. With Gobo pushing him to choose at all, he works out that he can make the decision his own way, even a fun one.
rows.resolution: The worry of choosing wrong eases once Wembley asks for help, and the choice he makes his own way turns out to count.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)'; confidence high. No controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Mokey starts to wonder whether eating Doozer constructions hurts the builders' feelings. Her answer is Convincing John, hired to persuade the Fraggles to stop.
rows.resolution: Mokey's guilt at the builders' hurt feelings becomes asking for help, and Convincing John is the helper she chooses.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only: emotion is a synopsis read (Mokey's concern for the Doozers) per the dev set note; confidence medium.

rows.story_lead: Everyone loves Mokey, and Red's answer to being loved is becoming someone else. She sets out to be just like Mokey.
rows.resolution: What the synopsis records is the jealousy itself; Red's way back to herself happens after its last line.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Wembley stumbles onto the legendary Terrible Tunnel, the place every Fraggle story warns about. Fear walks with him every step of the way.
rows.resolution: Inside the tunnel every Fraggle story warns about is where Wembley ends up; the synopsis does not show what he finds there.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low.

rows.segment_title: The Lost Treasure of the Fraggles
rows.story_lead: A map surfaces, said to lead to the Ancient Treasure of the Fraggles. Gobo and Red set off after it, happy on the trail of a real quest, and the synopsis keeps them there.
rows.resolution: The synopsis leaves the treasure hunt at its happiest point, before the map turns anything up.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only: candidate word excited carried for vocabulary review and tagged with the nearest ratified term happy; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Doc boards up the hole in the wall, and Gobo is trapped on the wrong side of it, alone in the human world. The way home is gone, for now.
rows.resolution: Trapped far from home is where the synopsis leaves Gobo; the way back opens after its last line.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only: content consideration carried, Gobo is trapped and alone in the human world; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low.

rows.segment_title: Catch the Tail by the Tiger
rows.story_lead: Two weeks pass with no postcard from Uncle Matt, and Gobo decides to leave the Rock and search Outer Space himself. Going after the grown-up you miss, into the place Fraggles fear, is the brave and the worried thing at once.
rows.resolution: Gobo's missing uncle gives the story its worry, and going after him gives it the bravery; what Gobo finds is past the synopsis's last line.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Mokey is named Ruler of the Rock, with three commands to spend and no idea which ones matter. No single command makes life better for everyone. Being in charge, she learns, is heavier than winning it.
rows.resolution: Holding power she cannot use well is Mokey's bind; asking for help is her way through, and no one rules a rock alone.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)'; confidence high. The Doc subplot models apologizing when he stops forcing his music on the neighbor.

rows.story_lead: Everyone in the Rock wants Wembley for something, and the wanting wears him down. Lou, who simply likes him for who he is, is the one who wants nothing.
rows.resolution: The loneliness of being wanted for what you do is the story, and being liked just for who you are is what the synopsis holds out.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only: emotion is a synopsis read per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Red challenges Gobo's leadership, and the two of them face off over who should be in charge of the Rock. The thin synopsis sets the contest and stops there.
rows.resolution: The synopsis sets the challenge and nothing else; who ends up in charge stays open.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only: thin synopsis (33 chars) per the dev set note; emotion and coping left empty rather than guessed; confidence low; resolution stays within synopsis evidence.

rows.story_lead: Boober hits the limit of having his feelings brushed off by everyone. The title, I Don't Care, says what he does with the caring, and the thin synopsis leaves the turn at that.
rows.resolution: The frustration of not being respected is the story, and 'I don't care' is the only shield the synopsis shows him raising.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Gobo holds the honor of greeting the Fraggle Moon at the festival, and Junior Gorg steals the Moon before he can. The month's Moon-Greeter is left with a festival and no moon.
rows.resolution: A stolen Moon on the night it is yours to greet is the worry the synopsis holds; the festival's ending is off the page.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low; no controlled topic fits (a moon festival is not a space story).

rows.story_lead: Boober's birthday arrives with exactly the disaster he always feared, and a cave-in leaves him trapped in the dark with Red. The two of them talk it through in the dark, the soap-bubble picture doing the gentle work.
rows.resolution: The fear of the cave-in gets talked out in the dark, and the birthday Boober dreaded is the one where talking is what helped.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: the trapped pair discusses dying, handled gently through a soap-bubble picture; birthday and party tags cover the frame.

rows.story_lead: Cantus brings his band of minstrels through the Rock, and every Fraggle must find their own song. Red's will not come.
rows.resolution: The synopsis holds the frustration of a song that will not come; Red finding hers happens off the page.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low.

rows.story_lead: The Trash Heap makes every radish in the Gorgs' garden vanish, to teach Fraggles, Doozers and Gorgs the same lesson. A garden gone empty is the lesson plan.
rows.resolution: A famine that touches all three worlds gives the story its worry; the synopsis stops short of the lesson landing.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low.

rows.story_lead: Fraggle Rock is squeezed from two sides at once: Sprocket smashes toward it from the wall, and Junior Gorg pounds from above. Home itself is under attack.
rows.resolution: Two attackers at once, one home at stake: the synopsis holds the fear and stops before the Rock is safe.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only: content consideration carried, the Fraggles' home is under attack from two sides; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Gobo loses his nerve for the postcard run and decides he is done exploring. Then he has to wonder whether exploring was ever really his own dream.
rows.resolution: The confused, sad question of whose dream exploring actually is carries the story; the retrieved script ends before Gobo's answer.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked; retrieved text truncated before the final resolution)'; coping left empty because the resolution was not in the retrieved text; the Doc subplot mirrors giving up after rejection letters; confidence medium; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Mokey is tired of being told she is no good at practical things, so she takes on Junior Gorg's Fraggle trap all by herself. Proving herself is the point, and the trap is the proving ground.
rows.resolution: The frustration of being underestimated turns into standing up for yourself, and Mokey handles the trap her own way.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only: title references a funeral but the synopsis gives no detail on it per the dev set note; confidence medium.

rows.story_lead: Wembley is caught between Red's splash-a-thon and a scary journey with Gobo, and he cannot bear to let either of them down. Choosing is the impossible part.
rows.resolution: Either way you choose, someone gets let down; the synopsis holds that worry and stops before Wembley picks.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low.

rows.story_lead: A shared dream points the Fraggles toward wisdom within themselves, and Mokey wakes up as the Rock's new Trash Heap. Gobo is the one who tells her the truth about it.
rows.resolution: The worry of an unwanted role gets talked out, and Gobo's truth-telling is the move the script shows.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked; retrieved text truncated before the final resolution)'; Gobo telling Mokey the truth is visible in the script per the dev set note; confidence medium; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Wembley tries to take care of a baby Tree Creature after its egg falls down the well and into the Fraggle Pond. Caring for a hatchling is a bigger job than he planned for.
rows.resolution: Keeping a wild baby alive is the worry; how the care ends is past the synopsis's last line.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low; no controlled topic fits (animal care; animal topics are deliberately outside the eight).

rows.story_lead: Boober has had enough of the Rock's noise, and he moves out to the Caves of Boredom. Leaving home to get some quiet is the plan.
rows.resolution: The Caves of Boredom are named, not shown; the synopsis stops at the frustration of a noisy home.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.segment_title: The Trash Heap Doesn't Live Here Anymore
rows.story_lead: Ma Gorg demands a gazebo, and Junior tears out the Trash Heap to build her one. Wembley and Boober have to figure out how to save her by themselves.
rows.resolution: Losing the Rock's wisdom to a Gorg garden project is where the synopsis ends; the rescue goes unrecorded.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Red is jealous of Gobo, and the jealousy takes a turn when she discovers a sea monster in Fraggle Rock. What she does with her discovery is past the synopsis's last line.
rows.resolution: The jealousy of a friend's spotlight is the story, and the sea monster is what it turns into; the synopsis does not show where the discovery leads.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low.

rows.story_lead: Gobo's postcard-writing uncle finally comes home from Outer Space, and the reunion turns out harder than Gobo hoped. Having the adventurer back is not the same as having him back the way he left.
rows.resolution: A homecoming gone sideways is where the synopsis stops; how the friction resolves is left open.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Boober's dreams will not leave him alone: his fun side, Sidebottom, keeps showing up and wants out to play. Sharing the dream with Wembley is what the Trash Heap's advice comes to.
rows.resolution: The fear of the stranger inside you gets talked out, and telling Wembley the dream is the move that helps.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked; retrieved text truncated before the final scene)'; sharing the dream with Wembley is the shown handling, per the Trash Heap's advice; content consideration carried: nightmare framing, gentle; confidence medium; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Mokey decides she wants to join the Minstrels and be a wandering musician herself. The Minstrels are Cantus's wandering band, and Mokey wants to wander with them.
rows.resolution: The thin synopsis carries only the wish itself: joining the Minstrels, nothing past it.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only: thin synopsis (46 chars) per the dev set note; emotion and coping left empty rather than guessed; confidence low.

rows.story_lead: Cotterpin Doozer does not want the worker's helmet everyone expects her to take. She wants to be a Fraggle instead, and saying so is the hard part.
rows.resolution: The frustration of a future chosen for you turns into standing up for yourself, and Cotterpin says what she actually wants.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; confidence medium; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Gobo and the gang dress up as the legendary Sir Hubris to scare the Gorgs into leaving the castle. The costume caper takes all of them.
rows.resolution: Costume caper, Gorgs ahead: the synopsis ends before anyone responds.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low; no controlled topic fits (a costume caper, not a legend story).

rows.story_lead: Sprocket the dog gets stuck in the hole between Outer Space and the Rock, and Gobo must help the beast he would normally run from. Helping means going toward the thing Fraggles fear.
rows.resolution: Helping a creature everyone fears is the brave choice the synopsis holds; how the rescue ends is off the page.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low.

rows.story_lead: Wembley trades identities with the Wizard, the shiftiest Fraggle in the Rock, and the Wizard is hiding an ulterior motive behind the swap. What looks like a game has an angle.
rows.resolution: The envy of the Wizard's freedom and the worry of the swap are the story; the retrieved script ends before the resolution.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked; retrieved text truncated before the resolution)'; coping left empty because the resolution was not in the retrieved text; confidence medium.

rows.story_lead: Flange and Modem Doozer square off in a building competition, the first the Doozers have held in years. Competing is new enough to be a big deal.
rows.resolution: Two Doozer builders, one contest: the source stops there, and the outcome stays open.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; emotion and coping left empty rather than guessed; confidence low.

rows.story_lead: Red founds a club so she can be the leader, and the idea takes off without her. Her membership ends up numbering one Cotterpin Doozer.
rows.resolution: The synopsis leaves Red with her one member and no next move; what she does with the club is off the page.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only: emotion is a synopsis read per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Wembley can never make up his mind, so he calls on Convincing John to decide things for him. Handing your choices to somebody else is its own kind of decision.
rows.resolution: The confusion of a Fraggle who cannot choose ends in asking for help, and Convincing John is the helper Wembley picks.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; confidence medium; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Gobo finds Doc's radio, and the voice coming out of it starts turning Fraggle against Fraggle. The thin synopsis ends the story there.
rows.resolution: A voice from upstairs divides the Fraggles; how they get back to one another goes unrecorded.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only: emotion is a synopsis read (the messages stir group conflict) per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Junior Gorg is tricked into selling the family castle to the smooth-talking Wander McMooch. The trickster talks, and Junior signs.
rows.resolution: The trick is done by the synopsis's last line; how it is undone is left open.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; emotion and coping left empty rather than guessed; content consideration carried: a trickster villain deceives Junior; confidence low; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Far from home, Mokey and Red find a colony of humorless, cruel Fraggles, and after Mokey is captured, both sides begin readying for war. A camping trip has turned into the opposite of fun.
rows.resolution: A captured friend, two camps marching toward war: the synopsis holds the fear and stops before the fighting is avoided.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only: content consideration carried, capture and war preparation between two Fraggle groups; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Gobo is chosen to write the Glory Song for the entire cave, just as the Ditzies, the creatures whose bodies light the Rock, begin to die. The song has a deadline, and the light does too.
rows.resolution: The sad weight of writing while the light dies is the story; the retrieved script ends mid-story, before the resolution.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked; retrieved text truncated mid-story)'; content consideration carried: the light-giving creatures are dying; coping left empty because the resolution was not in the retrieved text; confidence medium.

rows.story_lead: Boober's discarded laundry water and a failed radish gumbo combine into a soup with real magic in it. Nobody planned the magic, least of all Boober.
rows.resolution: The soup gets made and the magic gets loose; what the magic does is past the synopsis's last line.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; emotion and coping left empty rather than guessed; confidence low.

rows.story_lead: Red and Mokey decide to strike out together and find a cave of their own to live in. Living with a friend is the experiment.
rows.resolution: The thin synopsis holds the plan to share a cave and nothing more.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only: thin synopsis (54 chars) per the dev set note; emotion and coping left empty rather than guessed; confidence low; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Wembley beats his best friend Gobo in the Great Race, and the winning turns the friendship sour. Beating your best friend is a strange kind of winning.
rows.resolution: Strained at the finish line is where the story stands; how the two make up is not shown.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only: emotion is a synopsis read per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis shows no resolution; confidence low.

rows.story_lead: Young Wrench Doozer feels the full weight of peer pressure when everyone on his team starts flooping. What the crowd does, one Doozer has to decide alone.
rows.resolution: Going along or standing apart: the synopsis holds the worry and stops before Wrench decides.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; coping left empty because the synopsis does not show how Wrench handles the pressure; confidence low; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Boober's plan for a peaceful day falls apart when Sidebottom slips out of his dreams and starts stirring up trouble, beginning with a lie. The lie grows, and the quiet day gets further away.
rows.resolution: The guilty tangle of a lie that keeps growing is the story; the retrieved script ends before the resolution.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked; retrieved text truncated before the resolution)'; content consideration carried: lying escalates across the episode; coping left empty because the resolution was not in the retrieved text; confidence medium; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.segment_title: The Invasion of the Toe Ticklers
rows.story_lead: Mokey rescues a big furry caterpillar from the Gorgs and brings it home to the Rock, with no idea what will follow it in. What follows it in is nobody's plan.
rows.resolution: The caterpillar rescue is the last thing the synopsis shows; whatever followed it in is not recorded.
rows.evidence_note: Synopsis-only per the dev set note; emotion and coping left empty rather than guessed; confidence low; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.story_lead: Gobo has lost the feeling of the Festival of the Bells, so he sets off to find the Great Bell itself. The Fraggles at home grow dangerously cold while he searches, and Cantus teaches him that the heart of the Rock is the Fraggles who ring their bells together.
rows.resolution: The sadness and confusion of a holiday gone hollow get reframed by what Gobo finds: the bell he was looking for was everyone ringing together.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: the waiting Fraggles grow dangerously cold before Gobo returns.

rows.story_lead: Red wakes to find her radish bars gone, and she accuses her roommate Mokey without a shred of proof. The crook she is hunting turns out to be herself, asleep, and owning it happens in front of the entire Rock.
rows.resolution: The embarrassment and guilt of a false accusation end in apologizing, and Red learns what proof is for before the pointing starts.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: Red is publicly judged guilty of false accusation; the lesson is to get real proof before accusing anyone, and to apologize.

rows.story_lead: Boober dreads Joke Day and tries to sneak away from being silly in front of everyone. Then a glob that eats Doozers rolls into the Great Hall, and hiding or helping becomes the only choice that matters.
rows.resolution: Hiding is what the fear did to Boober; apologizing is what undid it, starting with his sorry to Cotterpin, and he learns he can act even when he is scared.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: the Glob swallows Doozers whole (they are freed unharmed); Boober apologizes to Cotterpin for not helping sooner.

rows.story_lead: Gobo finds the legendary Grapes of Generosity and eats them instead of sharing, which is the one thing the grapes are famously about. The magic floats him away weightless, and saving Red means admitting his greed out loud.
rows.resolution: The guilt of keeping what was meant for sharing ends in apologizing, and the confession is what brings Gobo back down to earth.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)'; confidence high. The grapes are magic and the lesson is sharing, per the dev set note.

rows.segment_title: Blanket Of Snow, Blanket Of Woe
rows.story_lead: Mokey keeps forgetting her promises, from Red's skate repair to the Trash Heap's tarpaulin, and the biggest one comes due the day the snow does. Marjorie freezes before the tarpaulin arrives, and Mokey sees what her lateness costs.
rows.resolution: The guilt and the anger of a broken promise end in apologizing, and Mokey learns to keep her word while the soup thaws what the cold took.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: Marjorie the Trash Heap appears frozen and lifeless before the soup thaws her; Red's anger at Mokey is explicit.

rows.story_lead: Gobo comes down with the Pebble Pox, and germ-worried Boober must journey to the Cave of Shadows for the cure. He shares his worries with Wembley the entire way there, and when it is his turn to be nursed, he learns being sick is a natural part of life.
rows.resolution: The fear of the Cave of Shadows and the dread of getting sick both get talked out, and the talking is what carries Boober to the cure and back.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: illness plot with fever, spots and a scary Cave of Shadows; no controlled topic fits the story.

rows.segment_title: Home Is Where The Trash Is
rows.story_lead: Philo and Gunge leave Marjorie to find a better home, and the search lands them in Wander McMooch's service, which is no home at all. Home, they learn, is the place where someone cannot live without you.
rows.resolution: The homesickness and the loneliness of a failed search are what the story holds, and the reunion with Marjorie says the lesson plainer than words: home is where someone cannot live without you.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: Wander McMooch keeps Philo and Gunge as slaves and Marjorie weakens toward death before they return; the reunion shows the resolution but no coping value from the list fits.

rows.story_lead: Wembley helps free a shape-changing creature the Gorgs call a monster, and what you believe is up to you. Meanwhile Doc cures Sprocket's fear of spiders and bugs by looking closer.
rows.resolution: Looking closer reframes the so-called monster, and the creature in the cage turns out to be Skenfrith, no monster at all.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: Skenfrith is kept caged as a pet by the Gorgs; Doc's subplot includes deliberate fear-cure exposure.

rows.story_lead: Wembley finds a genie who scares his friends and pushes him around, and the luck of the bottle curdles fast. His last wish teaches him the difference between standing up for yourself and just doing whatever you want: he sets the genie free.
rows.resolution: A wish gone wrong ends in standing up for yourself, and freeing the genie is the wish that takes the courage.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: the genie destroys belongings, scares Boober half to death and briefly turns the Fraggles into a marching Fraggle army.

rows.story_lead: Mokey gets a mysterious invitation to a secret society and works herself into a fret over its rules. The secret, it turns out, is a joke.
rows.resolution: The nervous fret over the society's rules gets reframed once the joke is out, and Mokey sets the worry down with the laughter.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)'; confidence high. No controlled topic fits the story.

rows.segment_title: The Beanbarrow, The Burden And The Bright Bouquet
rows.story_lead: Red has to race the Beanbarrow with Mokey's fussy plant Lanford after Mokey is delayed, and the two of them get trapped in a cavern by Clinging Creepers. Winning stops mattering; getting out matters, together.
rows.resolution: Trapped by Clinging Creepers, Red and Lanford get free by asking for help, and the two of them learn they make a real team.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: the Clinging Creepers attack and grab at Red and Lanford.

rows.story_lead: Gobo opens a school for explorers based on Uncle Matt's secret rules and follows them straight into the Hole to Who-Knows-Where. Rules, he learns, are no substitute for thinking for yourself.
rows.resolution: The confusion of a school whose rules fail is what the story holds, and thinking for himself is the lesson the Hole teaches.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)'; confidence high. The lesson is thinking for yourself, which no coping value on the list names, so coping is left empty per the dev set note.

rows.story_lead: Wembley tries to get even with Boober for scaring him, and the trap he sets is so scary he believes Boober has blown up. Getting back at someone, both of them learn, goes too far right about there.
rows.resolution: The scared panic and the guilty trap both end in apologizing, and the prank war stops where the fear started.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Forever Dreaming transcript, identity-checked)'; confidence high.
